summary: ansible-galaxy role info namespace.role shows all Galaxy metadata for a role, such as description, commit, repo, license, min Ansible version and download count.
questions: How do I see details about a Galaxy role before installing?
How do I check a role's minimum Ansible version?

answer_card.title: Show a role's Galaxy details
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role info username.role_name
```
Shows everything Galaxy knows: description, latest commit, GitHub user/repo/branch, license, `min_ansible_version`, download and star counts, and more.
